points: 0 of your 16 copy ads carry a proof number, so a first time buyer has no reason to trust a watch from a stranger. Pick a real figure, like orders shipped, and open the next batch with it.

5 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the watch in the creative, so the click loses its reason. Point each of those 5 ads to the exact product or collection it shows, such as the Datejust.
Your site promotes free shipping, yet 0 of your 16 copy ads mention it, so a new buyer gets no reason to order today. Put the free shipping offer in the first line of every ad in your next batch.

Your 16 copy ads open with 11 different stories, so no single hook builds momentum across the account. Pick the best openings, the Day-Date in blue and the daily drops, and build the next batch from them.
